ground_truth_criterion.method: full-length blastp of each genome's annotated proteome against the panel reference sets, plus the active-site residue criterion where a panel defines one

genomes.label: ecoli
genomes.organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655

genomes.label: spasteurianus
genomes.note: urdA — the source study's key organism

genomes.label: senterica
genomes.organism: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium str. LT2

experiments.name: balanced
experiments.description: All 24 validation genomes at equal cell abundance. Measures detection sensitivity and specificity when every gene that is present is present at a substantial fraction of the community.

community.label: ecoli
community.organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655

community.label: senterica
community.organism: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium str. LT2

experiments.name: negative
experiments.description: 6 abundant gut organisms with no known carriage of the target genes. Gene presence is verified from each proteome, so anything reported for an absent gene is a false positive. This is the experiment that measures the false-positive rate directly.

experiments.name: spike_0p05
experiments.description: Streptococcus pasteurianus spiked at 5.00% of cells into a background of non-carriers. Finds the abundance at which detection fails.

experiments.name: spike_0p01
experiments.description: Streptococcus pasteurianus spiked at 1.00% of cells into a background of non-carriers. Finds the abundance at which detection fails.

experiments.name: spike_0p002
experiments.description: Streptococcus pasteurianus spiked at 0.20% of cells into a background of non-carriers. Finds the abundance at which detection fails.

permissive.criterion: any matching fragment counts as a detection

confirmed.criterion: >= 2 matching fragments and >= 75% mean translated identity — the tier openbiota reports as 'confirmed'
